data.owner_reply: Hello, thank you for shopping with Temu. Your feedback is extremely valuable to us. To ensure transparency regarding delivery times, you can view the percentage of orders delivered within the expected timeframe for each product on the product details page. Please note that the estimated delivery time displayed on the product page is based on broader historical platform data. After your order is placed and shipped, the expected delivery date will be updated more accurately based on your order details, such as the quantity of items purchased, your delivery address, and the shipping method. You can track your shipping status and view the updated delivery estimate directly in the Temu app or on Temu.com. If your order arrives later than the estimated delivery date, you will receive Temu credits as a token of appreciation for your patience. Finally, if your items do not arrive, arrive damaged, or do not match the description or photos, you will be offered a full refund under Temu’s Purchase Protection program (https://www.temu.com/temu-purchase-protection.html). Warehouse confirmed delivery with a photo, but Temu refuses to refund my money!
I am extremely disappointed with Temu's customer service. I returned multiple items together in one package. Temu's warehouse successfully received the package and even sent me an official automated photo confirming delivery. In that photo, ALL my returned items are clearly visible inside the opened box.However, the system only processed a refund for one item, and Temu is now claiming that the other items were "not sent." Even after escalating this issue to higher supervisors and showing them their own warehouse photo as physical proof, they still refuse to issue my refund. This is an absolute scam and merchant fraud.My Order ID is [PO-010-00986395223672921]. If this issue is not resolved and my money is not refunded immediately to my Temu Credit Balance, I will file an official complaint with the Better Business Bureau (BBB) and initiate a Chargeback dispute through my bank using the warehouse photo as legal evidence. Fix this now!
